mutations.name: the daemon never reacts to a lease watch event (the loss window reverts to the renew period)
mutations.expectRed: L4 and the daemon's log names the watch-driven loss rather than a renew failure
mutations.cell: L4 and the daemon's log names the watch-driven loss rather than a renew failure
mutations.note: The watch trigger's own-write/foreign-write branch removed: every event, including the daemon's own acquire/renew/ready writes, is ignored. The loser still exits via the renew tick, so L5 can stay green while the loss window is back to ~15s; the cells that die are L3 (the 5s bound) and L4 (the watch-named loss line). Measured at the base shape: 14588ms.
